# Meghan Hair Studio

> Meghan Hair Studio is a boutique one-stylist color and cutting studio in Portland, Maine. Meghan Laura is a licensed cosmetologist with 18+ years of experience who trained on Boston's Newbury Street before returning to Portland. She specializes in vivid color, balayage, blonding, and precision cuts, and holds a perfect 5.0-star rating across 126 verified reviews on StyleSeat. The studio operates by appointment only, Tuesday through Saturday.

## About

- [About Meghan](https://meghanlaurahair.com/): Meghan Laura started her cosmetology career on Boston's Newbury Street and returned to Portland, Maine to open a boutique studio focused on expressive, dimensional hair color. She has 18+ years of professional experience. The studio is intentionally small — one stylist, one client at a time — prioritizing real conversation and results that reflect the client's personality. She is a licensed cosmetologist currently accepting new clients.

## Services

- [Haircuts](https://meghanlaurahair.com/): Bang Trim (15 min, clean dry hair required); 30-Minute Clean Up (kids of existing clients only, dry cut, no wash); Maintenance Cut (1 hr, dry cut, established clients or short hair only); Revival Cut (1.5 hr, includes consultation, shampoo, conditioning treatment, blow dry — all new and established clients); Transformation Cut (2 hr, for big changes, curly hair, and extreme density).
- [Color Services](https://meghanlaurahair.com/): Root Touch Up (45 min, blow dry not included); All Over Color (45 min, root-to-ends refresh, not for blonding); Partial Balayage (1.25 hr, highlights painted to top layer for sun-kissed brightness); Partial Custom Blonding (1 hr, custom technique tailored to individual look); Full Foil Highlights (2 hr, full head of highlights placed throughout all sections); Bleach and Tone (2 hr, bleach retouch with treatment and toner); Full Balayage (2 hr, highlights painted tip-to-root for blended brightness); Color Correction (time varies, complex correction and restoration, consultation required).
- [Consultation](https://meghanlaurahair.com/): Free 15-minute one-on-one session to evaluate hair condition and target look. Clients are encouraged to bring reference photos.

## Reviews and Social Proof

- [StyleSeat Reviews](https://www.styleseat.com/m/v/meghanlaurahair): 126 verified reviews with a 5.0-star average rating. Client-reported attributes: professional, personable, creative, attentive, meticulous, thorough, trendy, on time, kid-friendly, relaxing, easy parking.
- Selected client review: "Meghan is super knowledgeable, has great energy, extremely passionate about her work and your results — and provided me with the BEST cut and color transformation EVER. I couldn't be happier." — Anne (verified, Color Correction, Bleach and Tone, Kid's Cut).

- [Book an Appointment](https://www.styleseat.com/m/v/meghanlaurahair): All bookings made online through StyleSeat at styleseat.com/m/v/meghanlaurahair. Currently accepting new clients. Hours: Tuesday through Saturday, 9am to 6pm. By appointment only. Location: Portland, Maine.

## Optional

- Business type: Independent hair studio (solo stylist), not a multi-chair salon
- Specialization focus: Color artistry — particularly vivid, dimensional, and unexpected color work; balayage; blonding; color correction
- Location: Portland, Maine (Cumberland County)
- Experience background: Newbury Street, Boston before relocating to Portland
- Pricing: Listed on StyleSeat; not published on primary website. Color services generally range from $120 to $250+ depending on complexity. Cuts from $85. Exact quotes provided at booking.
